title: Complex charge-labelled U(1) MPS state representation
execution_status: Source-authored: complex U1 MPS core, dense fixed-charge factorization, U1 local gates, exact charge-block split, fixed cutoff/bond-cap compression, adaptive absolute local L2 error-budget compression, mixed-canonical receipts, canonical/gate/model-projection/compression error ledger, analytic U1 Hamiltonian gates and second-order Strang stepper. Consolidated exact-head Rust 1.96 harness pending.
claim_ceiling: Nearest-neighbour second-order Strang TEBD source is authored. The global L2 bound covers canonicalization, floating-gate defect, Hamiltonian-to-U1-model projection and Schmidt truncation under measured mixed-canonical assumptions. Trotter/time-discretization remains unqualified; no TDVP/MPO, matched performance, large-N advantage or quantum advantage claim.

conventions.left_boundary: single virtual state with charge zero
conventions.right_boundary: single virtual state with declared total charge

dense_to_mps.method: Sequential charge-block SVD at each cut, grouped by intermediate prefix charge q and suffix charge K-q.
dense_to_mps.truncation: No bond cap or positive singular-value cutoff. Exactly-zero singular directions are omitted as nullspace; every positive singular value is retained.
dense_to_mps.explicit_nonclaim: No two-site gate evolution or TEBD yet.

two_site_gates.gate_convention: Complex 4x4 row-major matrix in basis |00>, |01>, |10>, |11>; may mix |01> and |10>, but must not couple different total excitation sectors.
validations: two-site virtual charge selection rule after application
two_site_gates.claim_ceiling: Exact two-site contraction and gate application only; no charge-block SVD split or TEBD yet.

two_site_split.method: For each intermediate prefix charge q, factor the submatrix whose rows satisfy q_left+s1=q and columns satisfy q_right=q+s2. Independent complex SVD per q block.
two_site_split.truncation: No positive cutoff or bond cap. Omit exactly-zero singular directions only; retain every positive singular value.
two_site_split.claim_ceiling: Exact charge-block two-site SVD split only. No approximate truncation policy or TEBD yet.

policy.max_bond_dimension: Global across all admissible charge sectors.
policy.relative_singular_value_cutoff: Keep sigma_i >= relative_cutoff * sigma_max, where cutoff lies in [0,1].
policy.order: Apply relative cutoff first, then global bond cap to remaining singular values ranked descending across all sectors.

truncation.claim_ceiling: Local two-site approximate compression only; full TEBD scheduler and end-to-end circuit fidelity/error guarantee remain pending.

truncation_ledger.local_bound: sum_j sqrt(discarded_weight_j) in local two-site tensor Frobenius norm
truncation_ledger.global_bound: Recursive gate-by-gate: E_(k+1) <= ||G_k||_upper E_k + e_canonical,k*||G_k||_upper + e_gate,k + e_Hprojection,k + e_Schmidt,k*||L_k||_upper*||R_k||_upper. Components are propagated consistently through later gate operator-norm bounds.

gate_quality_bound.charge: sqrt(10)*max_abs_charge_off_block_entry*||psi_before_gate|| for the ten forbidden off-block entries of a 4x4 two-qubit matrix

assumptions: every canonical receipt verifies complete ordered coverage of exterior left/right charge-block isometries
every local split is an orthogonal Schmidt projection in that mixed-canonical gauge
gate unitarity and charge-conservation defects are measured and included by an operator-distance upper bound
Hamiltonian-to-U1 projection residual is measured and included by a Duhamel exponential upper bound
Trotter/time discretization error is excluded until separately qualified

tebd_layer_scheduler.schedule: Single parity layer; parity 0 uses bonds 0,2,4,..., parity 1 uses bonds 1,3,5,...; bonds sorted ascending and unique.
tebd_layer_scheduler.execution: For every deterministic parity-layer gate: canonicalize current MPS around target bond; measure exterior isometries; apply gate only when its unitarity and charge-conservation residuals pass the layer tolerance; split/truncate; record canonicalization, gate quality and projection contributions; revalidate entire U1 MPS.
tebd_layer_scheduler.reason: A local discarded Schmidt weight is not a global state-vector residual for arbitrary MPS gauge. Require mixed-canonical exterior isometry at every truncated bond, verified by a canonicalization receipt, before upgrading sum sqrt(w_j) to a global L2 bound.

canonical_gauge.sweeps: Independent U(1) charge-block SVD left/right sweeps; exact zero singular values omitted, every positive value retained.

acceptance: TEBD rejects a gate constructed using a looser tolerance than the active layer tolerance
global error ledger includes polar-unitary correction bound from gate unitarity residual
global error ledger includes charge-off-block residual bound
per-gate evidence records canonical gauge, gate quality and truncation in one object

hamiltonian_to_gate.construction: Finite complex 4x4 matrix; independently measures Hermiticity and charge-conservation residuals. Builds the nearest Hermitian U(1)-block-diagonal projection.
hamiltonian_to_gate.model_projection_bound: Duhamel bound |dt|*||H-H_projected||_F*exp(|dt|*max(||H||_F,||H_projected||_F)); attached to generated U1TwoSiteGate and accumulated as a separate global state-error contribution.

tebd_strang_stepper.schedule: even bonds exp(-i dt H_even/2), odd bonds exp(-i dt H_odd), even bonds exp(-i dt H_even/2)
tebd_strang_stepper.ledger: One global error ledger is passed through all three layers and can be continued across time steps.
tebd_strang_stepper.claim_ceiling: Nearest-neighbour second-order splitting only. Trotter error is not folded into the canonical/gate/model-projection/compression bound and remains unqualified pending step-refinement envelope or commutator bound.

policy.maximum_bond_dimension: Hard global cap over all charge sectors.
policy.maximum_absolute_local_l2_error: Absolute two-site reconstruction L2 residual target in amplitude units.
policy.minimum_rank: Smallest global Schmidt rank whose discarded squared tail is at most the square of the requested L2 budget, with tolerance-scaled comparison slack.
policy.achieved_error: Measured reconstruction_l2_residual, including factorization and tolerated forbidden-sector residuals.

error_budgeted_compression.failure: TruncationBudgetUnreachable returns the requested error, maximum bond, minimum required rank and best achievable measured residual under the cap.
error_budgeted_compression.claim_ceiling: Local two-site residual budget only. Global-state budget interpretation requires the canonical-gauge and gate/model error receipts; time-discretization error remains separate.

capabilities: singular-value cutoff and max-bond controls; comparison target for accuracy-budget policy
quimb.fairness: Same initial vector, gate sequence, qubit order, dtype, cutoff policy, bond cap, hardware and measurement checkpoints.
quimb.fidelity_and_error_semantics: CircuitMPS fidelity_estimate and error_estimate are norm-based estimates tied to truncation. They are internal controls, not the independent oracle; use dense-state L2 and infidelity for N<=12.
special_cases: auto-mps swaps and splits two-qubit gates
lazy/permutation MPS ordering must be included as separate baselines
CircuitMPSLazy supports delayed compression schedules; record compress_every and compression method separately.
CircuitPermMPS lazily tracks qubit/site ordering; record the logical-to-physical permutation and include the ordering-management cost.

capabilities: symmetry constraints propagated by QN-aware indices
itensor.fairness: Same problem instance and accuracy target; compare block sparsity, memory, time and error.
itensor.gpu_caveat: ITensor QN support is Abelian, which matches U(1). Its current GPU documentation cautions that QN block-sparse GPU operations are less mature than dense GPU operations and may not work or may be slower; report CPU and GPU comparisons separately.

competitive_baseline_matrix.differentiator: Per-operation charge-sector receipts, separation of truncation sources and cumulative error accounting with explicit assumptions.

quimb_lazy.fairness: Include eager CircuitMPS, CircuitMPSLazy and permutation-tracked MPS; match precision, state ordering, compression schedule, maximum bond and achieved error.

tdvp.fairness: Compare nearest-neighbour TEBD and long-range MPO/TDVP on the same Hamiltonian, initial state, total time, observables, precision and matched dense-reference error. Record projection variance, energy/norm drift, truncation, Krylov residual and runtime.

qiskit_aer.fairness: Translate the absolute L2 budget into measured dense-reference residual; do not equate Aer discarded-weight threshold directly with normalized-state L2 without matching input norm and normalization semantics.
qiskit_aer.truncation_semantics: matrix_product_state_truncation_threshold discards the smallest Schmidt coefficients whose summed squares fall below the configured threshold. mps_log_data reports bond dimensions and discarded values. This is not a global state-L2 certificate.
